name: Santa Clara County (Unincorporated)
disclaimer: Applies only to unincorporated Santa Clara County. Verify with Santa Clara County Planning Department.

notes: Unincorporated areas include Alum Rock, Cambrian, Saratoga Hills, etc.
County ADU design standards may apply in certain zoning districts.
Some hillside areas require geotechnical or fire clearance.

citations.general: Santa Clara County Zoning Ordinance Chapter 4 §4.10 (ADU)
